verdict.rationale: The core product is a set of MIT-licensed skill files that the installer writes into your own repo as ordinary editable files. Nothing updates behind your back, and updates are pulled manually with `npx skills update`, so the user fully owns and runs the product locally with any agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing this as self-hosting or offline use, and independent hands-on corroboration that the files work standalone without the npx installer or a marketplace.
